rosters.timestamp_basis: HTTP Last-Modified for the exact downloaded parquet bytes

injuries.timestamp_basis: Latest dated club or player report; each player expires independently; request time ignored

nflmeta.provider: NFLMeta weekly club game-status reports (per-club verification)

injuries.provider: NFLMeta per-club verified reports plus ESPN dated player reports
injuries.note: Only players of clubs with a complete verified NFLMeta report, or with an exact dated ESPN report, are cleared.

source: nflverse weekly rosters and injury reports
